changelog:
Initial release: Automatically replies with voice messages on Telegram after text replies.

- Adds voice mode toggle via user commands (e.g., “开语音”/“关语音”) with persistent `.voice-mode` file.
- Converts plain text reply to speech using edge-tts, removes Markdown formatting.
- Sends audio as Telegram voice message using fixed configuration (Chinese female voice).
- Graceful handling of errors: skips voice if generation or send fails, never interrupts normal conversation.
- Supports Windows 11 environment; requires edge-tts and preconfigured Telegram bot.
summary: 在 Telegram 渠道文字回复后自动将纯文本转换为中文活泼女声语音并发送语音消息，需开启语音模式和安装 edge-tts。
